maria: Follow-up from postmortem huddle 9: need short decisions on customer comms + remediation owners. Reply with emoji or a one-liner owner.
cheng: Ill draft the public status wording. Ops prefers 'service impact' language; legal wants numbers where available. I will produce two concise variants.
alex (legal): Public-facing should be high-level: time window, % affected, regions. For technical RCA sharing: deliver a redacted tech RCA through our secure portal or an NDA-guarded link. I'll send a 1-page redaction rubric. No internal creds, no PII.
sam: SRE suggested public blurb (can be shortened):
`10:120:48 UTC reduced inference throughput affecting ~12% of eu-west requests; autoscaler and cache warmup restored normal service.`
nina: Support report: three enterprise customers already requested RCAs. Proposed flow: public summary now + private, redacted RCA for affected accounts via secure link. I'll own the outreach.
maria: Owners needed for tracker and firm deadlines.
cheng: Status copy owner: @cheng. ETA: first-pass by EOD today, final post-signoff within 24h.
nina: Private RCA outreach owner: @nina. ETA: outreach template + secure-link flow by Friday EOD.
sam: Short-term remediation owner: @sam (autoscaler cooldown tweak). Due: 3 business days; I'll set exact date in the tracker. Medium/long-term items assigned to eng-runtime and platform teams in tracker.
alex (legal): I'll circulate the redaction rubric and quick signoff checklist by tomorrow morning.
infra-bot: Action created: PM-501 "Statuscopy + gated RCA plan" assigned to cheng,nina,sam, due 2026-03-27.
maria: Quick recap (confirm with emoji): statuscopy=cheng, gated RCA outreach=nina, legal rubric=alex, SRE short fix=sam. If no objections I will mark In Progress and add hard dates. :white_check_mark:
